column1: # Studies loaded by the permanent SSTR pipeline (/Jenkinsfile.permanent).
# TAB-separated. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored. Column order matters;
# trailing columns may be omitted (leave the tab-separated field empty to skip one).
#   study_id                   --study-id. Must match phs###### (exactly 6 digits).
#   input_uri                  --input. The dbGaP SSTR subject/sample mapping TSV
#                              (tab-delimited, with dbgap_subject_id, CONSENT,
#                              consent_abbreviation, dbgap_sample_id columns).
#   ready                      true/yes/1 to include in a full sweep; anything else skips it.
#                              A study is still loadable on demand via the STUDY_ID parameter
#                              regardless of this flag.
#   expected_consent_codes    Optional. Comma-separated CONSENT values this study must
#                              produce. When set, the load fails if the set does not match
#                              exactly -- this is the check that catches a file swapped for
#                              the wrong study or a mid-release consent change.
#   expected_min_participants  Optional. Floor on distinct participants. Catches a truncated
#                              or partially-staged input file.
#   instance_type              Optional. Overrides the tfvars default (m5.large) for studies
#                              whose SSTR file needs more memory.
# Every run of a study PURGES that study's existing consents rows and repopulates them from
# the file, in one transaction. Re-running a study is therefore safe and idempotent; running
# it against a truncated file is not, which is what expected_min_participants guards.
